query:
The right to privacy is the right of individuals to keep their personal actions and personal materials confidential and not to be illegally informed, in order to protect their reputation and image without violating the law.

The right of a suspected corruption offender to keep his source of income secret from the media is the right to privacy.

repl_history.response:
The preview itself defines what the right to privacy is - an individual's ability to keep their personal actions and materials confidential without violating the law. The second paragraph simply illustrates this concept, stating that keeping one's source of income secret from the media is also related.

 GLOBAL CONTEXT PREVIEW already has the definition, so I will provide a direct answer:

FINAL ANSWER: Confidentiality
